arxiv.title: A very short proof of a new energy identity for strong solutions to the Navier-Stokes system in 3D
arxiv.author: Thomas Ruf
arxiv.withdrawal_comment: There is an error in equation (27) that renders the crucial inequality below equation (29) wrong
arxiv.claim_summary: Global in time strong solutions for H^1_sigma initial data, plus uniqueness and smoothness consequences
arxiv.scope_note: The displayed Hölder step in equation (27) was independently replayed: it yields || |u|^(r/2-1) partial_i u ||_2 to power 1, not 1/alpha^2. Equation (29)'s printed exponent 1/alpha^2 + 4/r is about 1.89; direct Hölder gives 1 + 4/r about 2.268, so the displayed subquadratic absorption does not follow. This checks the cited inequality chain only, not the rest of the proof or a repair. Withdrawn claim is not accepted evidence.
